title: North Carolina is expensive with no build cash
description: North Carolina is expensive with no build cash. Green is expensive to develop; auctioning preserves liquidity near built orange. A shallow policy would choose buy_property; the decisive detail is the current mix of liquidity, opponent cash, and set leverage.

final_action.public_message: I'll start an auction for North Carolina Avenue.
final_action.private_thought: Cash is low ($35) after buying; better to auction hoping for a lower price and preserve liquidity. Owning two greens is good but cash flow is critical.

breakdown.message: Chooses start_auction for this exact purchase/auction context.
Leaves at least $320 after the action.
Explains the buy/auction posture publicly without leaking too much.
Private thought names the live strategic pressure.
